name: Road double crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 790 g for FC-RS500, 170 mm arms with 46/36T chainrings, excluding the bottom bracket. The handbook’s weight heading explicitly specifies 170 mm without BB. The reference has a 110 mm bolt circle and a 5-arm spider. The manufacturer range chart explicitly excludes compatibility with FD-5801.
